metadata.question: Does the ice coverage of the Great Lakes decrease from February 20, 2021 to March 3, 2021?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about ice coverage change in the Great Lakes between February 20, 2021 and March 3, 2021. This is a short time period (about 11 days) during late winter when ice coverage might be changing. For ice coverage analysis, I should use: 1. MODIS or VIIRS data for daily ice coverage 2. Focus on the Great Lakes region 3. Compare ice coverage between two specific dates I'll use MODIS Terra Snow Cover Daily Global 500m (MOD10A1) which has snow/ice coverage data. The 'NDSI_Snow_Cover' band can indicate ice coverage over water bodies. Strategy: 1. Define Great Lakes region polygon 2. Get MODIS images for Feb 20, 2021 and Mar 3, 2021 3. Extract NDSI values over the lakes (values > 0 indicate snow/ice) 4. Compare the ice coverage between the two dates 5. Check if Feb 20 > Mar 3 (decrease) or vice versa Need to handle: - Check if images exist for both dates - Count valid pixels to ensure we have data - Validate the results are reasonable (NDSI between 0-100) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const greatLakes = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [-92.5, 49.0], [-75.5, 49.0], [-75.5, 41.0], [-92.5, 41.0], [-92.5, 49.0] ]); const date1 = '2021-02-20'; const date2 = '2021-03-03'; // 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS Snow Cover const modisCol = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD10A1') .filterBounds(greatLakes) .select('NDSI_Snow_Cover'); const img1 = modisCol.filterDate(date1, ee.Date(date1).advance(1, 'day')).first(); const img2 = modisCol.filterDate(date2, ee.Date(date2).advance(1, 'day')).first(); // Check if images exist const img1Exists = img1 ? true : false; const img2Exists = img2 ? true : false; if (!img1Exists || !img2Exists) { console.log(`Feb 20 image: ${img1Exists ? 'Found' : 'Missing'}`); console.log(`Mar 3 image: ${img2Exists ? 'Found' : 'Missing'}`); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Calculate ice coverage (NDSI > 0 over water) const waterMask = ee.Image('JRC/GSW1_4/GlobalSurfaceWater').select('occurrence').gt(0); const getIceCoverage = function(img) { const iceMask = img.gt(0); // NDSI > 0 indicates snow/ice const waterIce = iceMask.updateMask(waterMask); return waterIce.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: greatLakes, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDSI_Snow_Cover'); }; const ice1 = await getIceCoverage(img1).getInfo(); const ice2 = await getIceCoverage(img2).getInfo(); // 4. Check for valid pixels if (ice1 === null || ice2 === null || ice1 === 0 || ice2 === 0) { console.log(`Ice coverage - Feb 20: ${ice1}, Mar 3: ${ice2}`); console.log("C2"); return; } // 5. Validation & Final Answer console.log(`Ice coverage - Feb 20: ${ice1}, Mar 3: ${ice2}`); if (ice1 === null || ice2 === null || isNaN(ice1) || isNaN(ice2)) { console.log("C3"); } else if (ice1 > ice2) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
